purpose: Authoring reference, not evidence of implemented geometry.

ember.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: isolated hair model reference sheet for a modular illustrated videogame avatar. The attached image is a design reference, not an edit target. Produce an accurate isolated study of ONLY the hairstyle from that reference. EMBER compact coiled crop: dark chestnut short sides, dense rounded interlocking coiled locks across a low dome crown, naturally irregular rounded rectangular curl clusters with a few incised C-shaped ink seams. The supplied Ember hairstyle is the exact design. Reproduce it, not tall spikes, spherical beads or a flat top.
Cream paper background; four large aligned orthographic studies labeled FRONT, SIDE, BACK, TOP, in a precise 2x2 layout, same hairstyle, same scale. Include a very faint neutral gray head/ears as a fitting mannequin so hair attachment and openings are unambiguous; no face features, no torso, no clothes. Front straight-on, side strict left-facing profile, back straight-on, top straight overhead. Make all views internally consistent with the same lock landmarks. Deliberate angular silhouette accents over smoothly connected flowing masses, strong expressive black ink outlines, two or three broad cel-shaded color families with sparse hand-drawn directional hair strokes. No photorealistic strand hair, no glossy shading, no triangulated rendering overlay or wireframe, no extra hairstyle alternatives. Favor the reference's actual silhouette and direction over inventing details. This will be used to sculpt a real game asset from every angle.
